scope: Forty-two sentence-audited demonstrative genitive/locative plural tih/Tih tokens: one in 45-isv.tex and 41 in base-papers1-43-isv.tex.
choice: Replace 41 lowercase tih tokens with tyh and the one sentence-initial Tih token with Tyh, using the exact audited locator set.
motivation: Official demonstrative-pronoun morphology requires tyh for genitive/locative plural; every audited occurrence means of/in those and none belongs to the unrelated tihy quiet adjective.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining tih would preserve a noncanonical demonstrative inflection.
An unrestricted future global rule was rejected because a short form of the separate adjective tihy could be legitimate in another context.
Changing the permitted alternate demonstrative těh was rejected; it is outside this exact family.

evidence.official_grammar: Official pronouns.md lines 68-80 gives the toj demonstrative paradigm and explicitly lists plural tyh, tym, tymi, with only těh/těm/těmi as alternates.
evidence.semantic_audit: All 42 source sentences use the token demonstratively with an explicit plural noun or nominal antecedent; valid quiet-adjective holds in the current source set are zero.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a TeX comment, control-sequence name or foreign-language argument.

validation.prehashes: All four inputs matched the frozen EDIT-0093 successor state before application.
validation.coverage: Exact pre-count 42: 41 lowercase tih and one uppercase Tih, each selected at its audited source locator.
validation.postcondition: Whole-token tih/Tih is zero; case-insensitive tyh/Tyh totals 198 across the four Latin components.
validation.structure: Ordered TeX controls, braces, math delimiters and line counts are invariant; unchanged components are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: Frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic replacement of the two changed source files.
